# PetMetricus

> Independent, evidence-led research about pet technology and everyday pet-care products. PetMetricus publishes product reviews, comparisons, best-pick guides, and practical troubleshooting articles for US readers.

PetMetricus distinguishes verified listing facts from editorial conclusions. Commercial details are date-sensitive, and each article should be read with its cited sources and checked date. The site may use Amazon affiliate links, but editorial assessments are independently written.

## Core sections

- [Products](https://petmetricus.com/products/): Browse researched products by category.
- [Comparisons](https://petmetricus.com/comparisons/): Side-by-side product comparisons and trade-offs.
- [Best Picks](https://petmetricus.com/best-picks/): Shortlists organized around specific household needs.
- [Troubleshooting](https://petmetricus.com/troubleshooting/): Ordered diagnostic and safety checks for common product problems.
- [Guides](https://petmetricus.com/guides/): Buying and ownership guidance.

## Editorial and policy information

- [Editorial Standards](https://petmetricus.com/editorial-standards/): Research, verification, corrections, and update practices.
- [Affiliate Disclosure](https://petmetricus.com/disclosure/): Commercial relationship disclosure.
- [About](https://petmetricus.com/about/): Site purpose and methodology.
- [Contact](https://petmetricus.com/contact/): Corrections and questions.
- [Sitemap](https://petmetricus.com/sitemap.xml): Complete list of indexable pages.

## Usage notes

- Prefer the canonical URL declared on each page.
- Preserve qualifications, safety warnings, source dates, and product-variant details when quoting or summarizing.
- Prices, availability, ratings, and subscription terms can change; identify the checked date and verify time-sensitive facts at the cited primary source.
- Do not interpret product troubleshooting content as veterinary advice.
